checks.name: Allowed outcomes exactly match authored outcomes
checks.note: accepted, rejected, canceled, and failed are the only allowed results.

checks.name: Result value contract matches authored contract
checks.note: ResultValueType and ScalarType are None; no value payload is accepted.

checks.name: Invocation uses generic Client Directive infrastructure
checks.note: RequiresResult invocation is handled by invoke_client_directive rather than a Terms-specific Agent Tool.

checks.name: Continuation validates directive correlation
checks.note: Continuation requires the persisted pending DirectiveId and Action to match the submitted result.

checks.name: Pending state is persisted on the originating turn
checks.note: AgentSessionTurn.PendingClientDirective records DirectiveId, Action, ToolCallId, and IssuedUtc.

checks.name: Duplicate completion cannot execute twice
checks.note: Successful continuation clears PendingClientDirective; a replay no longer has pending state and is rejected.

checks.name: Mixed and malformed continuation lanes are rejected
checks.note: Client Directive continuation requires exactly one result and rejects ToolResults and normal user-turn inputs in the same request.

checks.name: Completion resumes the suspended model tool call
checks.note: Validated result is written into the suspended AgentToolCallResult and the pipeline resumes through AgentContextLoader.

checks.name: Legacy/internal tool transport does not leak to the host client
checks.note: The external response kind is client_directive_continuation and suspended internal ClientToolCall state is not exposed as the host contract.

sourceEvidence.note: Terms-specific definition: action, RequiresResult mode, exact outcomes, empty payload schema, and no result value.
Generic RequiresResult invocation, server-generated directive id, payload validation, and pending-turn persistence.
Continuation lane validation, correlation, contract validation, duplicate protection, tool result application, and resume path.
Translates the suspended internal tool state to the dedicated external Client Directive continuation response.

supportingTests.note: Definition-level tests exist for action, response mode, exact outcomes, no-value contract, accepted outcomes, scalar rejection, and unknown outcome rejection. Execution status is intentionally not inferred from source presence.
Generic Core contract tests exercise bounded ClientDirectiveResult shape validation. Execution status is intentionally not inferred from source presence.

notes: Final server sign-off is a source-backed code review. Unit tests are supporting evidence, not a mandatory per-interaction gate.

No additional Terms-specific unit tests were added because the unique server implementation is declarative and already covered by source inspection plus existing definition tests; the material behavior lives in generic Client Directive infrastructure.
For a later interaction with interaction-specific server behavior, targeted unit tests should be added and their AptixEvidence results may be linked here.
